# sigma_templates (Data Source)

Lists Sigma templates. Results preserve Sigma API order; key collections by returned IDs rather than positional indices. Pagination cursors and page sizes are not exposed; this data source retrieves every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_templates" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Search filter (`search`).
- `source` (String) Template source filter (`source`): `internal` or `external`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.
- `templates` (Attributes List) Templates in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator member ID.
- `id` (String) Template ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the template is archived.
- `latest_version` (Number) Latest template version.
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `path` (String) Template path.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Version tags on the template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) Update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater member ID.
- `url` (String) Template URL.
- `url_id` (String) Template URL ID.

<a id="nestedatt--templates--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates.tags`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Tag name.
- `version_tag_id` (String) Version tag ID.
